# Optional Vazirmatn font

- Upstream: https://github.com/rastikerdar/vazirmatn/tree/v33.003
- Original file: `fonts/webfonts/Vazirmatn[wght].woff2`, variable weights 100–900.
- Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rastikerdar/vazirmatn/v33.003/fonts/webfonts/Vazirmatn%5Bwght%5D.woff2
- Original byte size: 111,152.
- SHA-256: `4e3fa217d38fdafc1fea4414ceb58ca5e662cf0ab5fa735a8c8c20e8b42cad92`.
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, retained in `OFL.txt`.

The unmodified font bytes are base64-encoded in `vazirmatn.js` for offline `file://`
compatibility and self-contained HTML/SVG exports. That local script loads only when
Vazirmatn is selected. The font is not installed into the operating system and does not
replace default application fonts. Other choices refer to families installed by the user;
no proprietary or system font files are copied into the application or exports.
